key.name: window-width
key.description: Width of the main window in logical pixels.

key.name: window-height
key.description: Height of the main window in logical pixels.

key.name: is-maximized
key.description: Whether the main window was maximized when it last closed.

key.name: default-page-size
key.description: How many rows a table page fetches at a time.

key.name: confirm-destructive
key.description: Ask before dropping a table, deleting rows, or discarding pending edits.

key.name: history-retention-days
key.description: Unpinned history entries older than this are pruned at startup. Zero keeps everything.

key.name: query-timeout-secs
key.description: How long the editor waits before cancelling a running query. Zero disables the timeout.

key.name: use-system-font
key.description: Whether the SQL editor follows the desktop monospace font instead of a custom one.

key.name: custom-font
key.description: Pango font description the SQL editor uses when the system font is turned off.

key.name: style-scheme
key.description: GtkSourceView style scheme id for the SQL editor.

key.name: csv-null-to-empty
key.summary: Write NULL as an empty field
key.description: Whether a CSV export writes NULL as an empty field rather than the text NULL.

key.name: csv-line-break-to-space
key.description: Whether a CSV export flattens line breaks inside a value into single spaces.

key.name: csv-header-row
key.description: Whether a CSV export starts with the column names.

key.name: csv-sanitize-formulas
key.description: Whether a CSV export prefixes values starting with =, +, - or @ so a spreadsheet does not run them.

key.name: csv-delimiter
key.description: Character that separates fields in a CSV export.

key.name: csv-quote
key.description: When a CSV export wraps a field in quotes.

key.name: csv-line-break
key.description: Line ending a CSV export writes between records.

key.name: csv-decimal
key.description: Character a CSV export uses between the whole and fractional parts of a number.
